If the heroes had somehow let LC survive into Round 10 she had a Raiding Party waiting to go.

It did see-saw nicely for a while with LC hitting hard out of the gate.  The heroes luck turned for the better around the time the entire villain deck got put in the trash and they managed to knock out the initial avalanche of crew.  From then on villain deck plays were relatively tame and the heroes got things in hand, especially once the Dynamic Siphon - Cleansing Downpour - Blatant Reference combo kicked into play to start healing the heroes up along with allowing Scholar to heal and trash LC at the same time.

I need to get more familiar with the Guise, Sky-Scraper, and Captain Cosmic decks myself.  I can generally recall what most of the cards do by title in the older decks, but not with the new heroes yet.

Episode 40 will probably go back to randomized heroes, and probably not get started until next week.
